predecessors.name: Vandal Kingdom
predecessors.text: the Aures Mountains, which revolted against the Vandal king Huneric; 'the Aures kingdom was fully independent' by his death in 484

successors.name: Umayyad Caliphate
successors.text: the Kahina's 'sovereign Berber state from the Aures Mountains to the oasis of Ghadames' (698-703)

ledger.x: 484: the Aures breaks from the Vandals.
698: the Kahina meets Hasan at Meskiana.
698: the Kahina rules from the Aures to Ghadames.
703: the Kahina falls and the Aures is conquered.

wars.name: Berber revolt against the Vandals
wars.outcome: Berbers fought the Vandals under Gunthamund and Thrasamund; the Aures kingdom was 'fully independent' by Huneric's death in 484.

wars.name: Byzantine reconquest of the Aures (Solomon's campaigns)
wars.outcome: The Byzantines conquered the Aures in 539 and held it until 544, when the kingdom was re-established after the Battle of Cillium.

wars.name: Hasan ibn al-Nu'man's campaign against the Kahina
wars.outcome: After Carthage fell Hassan marched into the Aures; the Kahina razed Baghaya and defeated him at Meskiana in 698; he withdrew to Cyrenaica for five years.

wars.name: Battle of El Jem and the end of the Kahina
wars.outcome: Dihya was defeated at El Jem in Ramadan 703 and killed near Bir al-Kahina in the Aures; her head was sent to Abd al-Malik at Damascus.

certainty.note: A mountain kingdom: no page gives a frontier.
